item.title: Sawgrass LNG & Power celebrates eight years of LNG supply to Bahamas
item.description: Sawgrass LNG & Power has celebrated eight years of LNG exports to The Bahamas, marking a significant milestone in US-Bahamian energy co-operation.

item.title: Harnessing digital innovations to optimise LNG transportation efficiency
item.description: In our November 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Nick Fryer, Vice President of Marketing, Sheer Logistics, addresses the challenges facing modern LNG transportation and explores the digital innovations that can be implemented to combat them.

item.title: ViGo Bioenergy acquires Drive Systems
item.description: ViGo Bioenergy has announced the acquisition of Drive Systems, Belgium’s leading independent LNG station network.

item.title: PETRONAS signs supply agreement with CNOOC
item.description: PETRONAS has entered into a sale and purchase agreement with CNOOC Gas and Power Singapore Trading & Marketing Pte. Ltd for the supply of 1 million tpy of LNG.

item.title: Turning LNG oversupply into opportunity: Why Africa’s gas future depends on infrastructure
item.description: While geopolitical risks and potential project delays could shift this balance, the prospect of sustained LNG surplus poses a critical question for Africa: how can the continent strengthen domestic gas value chains to shield itself from global market volatility?

item.title: Woodside and BOTAS finalise long-term LNG supply agreement
item.description: Woodside and BOTAS have signed a sale and purchase agreement for the long-term supply of LNG.

item.title: First US LNG cargo for Bulgaria arrives in Alexandroupolis
item.description: METLEN has delivered its first US LNG cargo in Alexandroupolis, destined to supply the Bulgarian market.

item.title: Wison New Energies holds hull launching ceremony
item.description: Wison New Energies has held the Genting FLNG project hull launching ceremony and 10 million manhours LTI free celebration at its Nantong Yard.

item.title: Supermajority of Louisiana State Senators express support for LNG export facility
item.description: A supermajority of 36 Louisiana State Senators has adopted a resolution expressing full support for the development, construction, and long-term operation of Argent LNG, an LNG export facility in Port Fourchon, the US.

item.title: CIMC selects TMC Compressors for Golar FLNG facility
item.description: CIMC Raffles has contracted TMC Compressors to deliver a complete marine compressed air system to the MK2 FLNG facility being constructed for Golar LNG Ltd.
